verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents first-party integration with Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, Hono and 20+ more frameworks, plus server-side `auth.api` methods for authenticating users. Community users confirm consistent use across frameworks, and one team moved from Next.js to Hono by changing only the router. However, the pack never documents route-protection middleware or session verification at the edge. The JWT/JWKS plugin is only a building block for that and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented route-protection middleware, edge-runtime session verification, per-framework middleware examples, hands-on corroboration of edge protection.

support.subject: As a developer, I can protect routes with first-party framework SDKs and middleware (Next.js and peers) that verify sessions at the edge

citations.quote: Works with your stack. Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, Hono, and 20+ more.
To authenticate a user on the server, you can use the `auth.api` methods.
The setup is easy and the usage is consistent framework to framework.
